radar.scoreMeaning: V4.4 candidateQuality, timingScore, entrySignal and runner fields are preserved. V4.5 entryStage semantics remain behavior-based; V4.6 adds lightweight CVD dynamics, microprice, spread, relative-strength and absorption adjustments that cannot trigger Entry alone.
